spec.rationale: Creator 2020-01-14 'Roses are White but often Red. Yellow has a number and so does Blue' + 'go back to the first puzzle piece' + primes/zeroing. The red divider (#ED1C24, 15px, resistor 2) is flagged in the repo as 'barely used'. This family uses RED=2 as a genuine operand on the resistor-coded first-image grid, with prime-index zeroing, gated against the prize.
